source_prose:
Hi Mariana,

Confirming Coastal Spell for 3/14.

Deal is $5,000 vs 80% of net after expenses. Expenses capped at $2,500, marketing recoup of $900 against gross. Hospitality cap $500. +$1k bonus over $25k gross.

Best, Andrea

ambiguities.prose_span: Expenses capped at $2,500, marketing recoup of $900 against gross
ambiguities.description: The $900 marketing recoup could be positioned off-gross (in addition to the $2,500 expense cap) or treated as inside the $2,500 cap. The two readings produce different settlement totals at ~$720 apart.

candidate_readings.label: Off gross (in addition to cap)
candidate_readings.interpretation: The $900 is deducted from gross BEFORE fees and expenses. The $2,500 cap applies separately to other operational expenses.
candidate_readings.estimated_impact: Reduces artist payout. At ~$20k gross, this reading yields roughly $720 less to the artist than the alternative.

candidate_readings.label: Inside cap
candidate_readings.interpretation: The $900 marketing recoup counts as part of the $2,500 expense cap. The venue absorbs any operational+marketing spend above $2,500.
candidate_readings.estimated_impact: Higher artist payout by roughly $720 at typical show gross.

ambiguities.suggested_clarification: Quick clarification on the deal: is the $900 marketing recoup inside the $2,500 expense cap, or in addition to it? Want to lock this in before we settle.
